forum.title: STM32N647Z0 failed to create the download file for mx25um51245 external flash
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@liuqw ,

Can you try setting the optimization to “Optimize for size (-Os)” when building the external loader.
forum.content_text:
I want to create an MX25UM51245G. sldr, but it keeps failing with a prompt

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/3e4921fa-6d03-4202-8910-3333b52e2456.png)

Use the official MX25UM51245G\_STM32N6570-NUCLEO.stldr to confirm that the board can be downloaded successfully

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/946f96fe-8aa7-43f7-90de-bca609da5135.png)

Please check the MX configuration that I generated for MX25UM51245G\_STM32N6\_ ExtMemLoader. stldr
